warnings: *** THE EAVES SOFFIT SPEC HERE CONTRADICTS A-02 AND A-03 ON TWO NUMBERS, AND ALL THREE ARE RECORDED AS PRINTED. *** This detail says ฝ้าไม้เนื้อแข็ง 1/2"x2" ตีเว้นร่อง 10 มม. on โครงเคร่าไม้ยาง 1 1/2"x3" @0.60 ม. A-02 (รายการประกอบแบบ) says the same boards but เว้นร่อง 0.5 ซม. (= 5 mm) on โครงเคร่าไม้เนื้อแข็ง. A-03's ฝ3 legend also says 5 มม. and ไม้เนื้อแข็ง. So the gap is 10 mm here against 5 mm on two other sheets, and the batten timber is ไม้ยาง here against ไม้เนื้อแข็ง on two others. Two sheets agree against one on both points, but this is the enlargement - the sheet drawn at 1:25 specifically to detail the assembly - so neither side is simply wrong. Recorded verbatim on each sheet's own file with this warning on all three; no value was averaged or silently harmonised. Per the op1 precedence list this is the 'more sheets agreeing beats fewer' case pulling against 'the detail sheet wins', which is exactly why it is escalated in writing instead of decided quietly.
The two enlargements are recorded as one section file for the same reason as A-06's pair: they are two cuts of one roof assembly under one title-block entry and one scale.
No dimension other than the timber sizes and the 0.60 batten spacing is printed on either enlargement.
